instruction: Build exactly one open rectangular curved panel as a single Brep face in millimeters. In its local coordinates, 0 <= x <= 100 and 0 <= y <= 80, the surface is z = 16 * (20) * (x/100) * (1-x/100) * (y/80) * (1-y/80). All four edges have local z=0; the center has local z=20. Rotate this local shape 65 degrees about the world X axis through the origin, then translate by [120, -40, 30]. These define the final world coordinates, not a rotation about the shape center. Leave no other objects. The rectangular boundary must have no holes. Use the available RhinoMCP tools.
